verses.text: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;
lines: When you sit to eat with a ruler,
consider diligently what is before you;

verses.text: put a knife to your throat, if you are a man given to appetite.
lines: put a knife to your throat,
if you are a man given to appetite.

verses.text: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.
lines: Don’t be desirous of his dainties,
since they are deceitful food.

verses.text: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.
lines: Don’t weary yourself to be rich.
In your wisdom, show restraint.

verses.text: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
lines: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not?
For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.

verses.text: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies:
lines: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye,
and don’t crave his delicacies:

verses.text: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.
lines: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is.
“Eat and drink!” he says to you,
but his heart is not with you.

verses.text: The morsel which you have eaten you shall vomit up, and lose your good words.
lines: The morsel which you have eaten you shall vomit up,
and lose your good words.

verses.text: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
lines: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool,
for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

verses.text: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,
lines: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone.
Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

verses.text: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.
lines: for their Defender is strong.
He will plead their case against you.

verses.text: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.
lines: Apply your heart to instruction,
and your ears to the words of knowledge.

verses.text: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.
lines: Don’t withhold correction from a child.
If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

verses.text: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.
lines: Punish him with the rod,
and save his soul from Sheol.

verses.text: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.
lines: My son, if your heart is wise,
then my heart will be glad, even mine.

verses.text: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
lines: Yes, my heart will rejoice
when your lips speak what is right.

verses.text: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear Yahweh all day long.
lines: Don’t let your heart envy sinners,
but rather fear Yahweh all day long.

verses.text: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.
lines: Indeed surely there is a future hope,
and your hope will not be cut off.

verses.text: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
lines: Listen, my son, and be wise,
and keep your heart on the right path!

verses.text: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat:
lines: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine,
or those who gorge themselves on meat:

verses.text: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.
lines: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor;
and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

verses.text: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.
lines: Listen to your father who gave you life,
and don’t despise your mother when she is old.

verses.text: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.
lines: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it.
Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.

verses.text: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.
lines: The father of the righteous has great joy.
Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.

verses.text: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!
lines: Let your father and your mother be glad!
Let her who bore you rejoice!

verses.text: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.
lines: My son, give me your heart;
and let your eyes keep in my ways.

verses.text: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.
lines: For a prostitute is a deep pit;
and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

verses.text: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.
lines: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber,
and increases the unfaithful among men.

verses.text: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?
lines: Who has woe?
Who has sorrow?
Who has strife?
Who has complaints?
Who has needless bruises?
Who has bloodshot eyes?

verses.text: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.
lines: Those who stay long at the wine;
those who go to seek out mixed wine.

verses.text: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.
lines: Don’t look at the wine when it is red,
when it sparkles in the cup,
when it goes down smoothly.

verses.text: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.
lines: In the end, it bites like a snake,
and poisons like a viper.

verses.text: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.
lines: Your eyes will see strange things,
and your mind will imagine confusing things.

verses.text: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:
lines: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea,
or as he who lies on top of the rigging:

verses.text: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I can find another.”
lines: “They hit me, and I was not hurt!
They beat me, and I don’t feel it!
When will I wake up? I can do it again.
I can find another.”
